name: backend-design-by-data
title_zh: 先定写路径再画表的后端存储设计
tagline_zh: 需求还没落成表，先逼你把写路径、幂等、原子性想清楚。DDL 和索引只是最后一步，不是第一步。
tagline_en: Before any table exists, it forces you to nail write paths, idempotency, atomicity. DDL and indexes come last.
desc_en: Use when designing the data layer of a backend service — modeling tables or documents from requirements, writing DDL, choosing SQL vs document DB, designing idempotent or atomic write paths, minimizing DB round-trips, deciding constraints and indexes, planning schema evolution, or deciding whether multi-system updates need a message queue.
why_zh: 多数设计工具从 ER 图开始，它从数据怎么被写入开始——先定约束和往返次数，再谈 schema。
why_en: Most tools start with ER diagrams; this starts with how data gets written—constraints and round-trips first, schema later, so.
limit_zh: 只覆盖数据层设计决策，不生成业务代码或 API 契约。需要你已具备需求文本；若需求含糊到连写路径都说不清。
limit_en: Covers data-layer design only—no business code or API contracts. Needs a requirements doc; if write paths are vague, it interrogates rather than.
title_en: Backend storage design: write path first, tables second
